$comment: Open font bundle (specs/2026-09-11-open-items-design.md section 1): no proprietary file is redistributed; the claimed OS's families resolve to metric-compatible or coverage-compatible OFL fonts through strong fontconfig aliases (scripts/gen_fontconfig.py). scripts/fetch_fonts.py downloads `bundle` into fonts/ (git-ignored) and fills sha256 on first fetch. families.* are captured by scripts/capture_fonts_list.py, not authored.

bundle.name: Noto Sans CJK
bundle.why: one OTC with the five regional forms (19.5 MB) replaces the SC-only OTF (16 MB): Japanese/Korean/Traditional claims render their own glyph forms

bundle.name: Gelasio
bundle.why: designed metric-compatible with Georgia (SorkinType); kept only while verify_font_metrics M3 holds

bundle.name: Wine Tahoma
bundle.why: the Wine project's Tahoma replacement; its name table says Tahoma, so it resolves by its own name with no alias; kept only while verify_font_metrics M4 holds

probe_text.$comment: verify_fonts_bundle.py measures each family with a string both Liberation fallbacks and the class's target font have glyphs for (a glyph absent from both fallbacks is served by the same system fallback either way and would read as resolved). Latin for every class whose target has Latin glyphs (Noto Sans CJK does); the card suits for symbol and emoji fonts, which have no Latin.
